query: How would HelpfulnessNumerator change if reviews provided more detailed product information?

per_column.name: product_detail_depth
per_column.rationale: Directly operationalizes 'more detailed product information' -- the intervenable lever the query asks about. Authors can decide how much product detail to include.

per_column.name: comparative_reference
per_column.rationale: A specific facet of providing detailed product information (comparisons to other products); a settable/editable content choice, part of the treatment construct.

per_column.name: usage_instruction
per_column.rationale: Whether the review includes usage instructions is another dimension of detailed product information; an authorable, intervenable content property.

per_column.name: sensory_description_depth
per_column.rationale: Depth of sensory description is another sub-dimension of the detail-provision treatment; settable by the writer.

per_column.name: review_narrative_type
per_column.rationale: Narrative type is largely a consequence/expression of how the review is written; it lies on the path between detail choices and helpfulness rather than being a common prior cause. Treated as mediator, not a confounder.

per_column.name: review_sentiment_valence
per_column.rationale: Sentiment can drive both how much detail a reviewer supplies and how helpful readers rate the review, so it is a plausible common cause requiring adjustment. Not named in the query.

per_column.name: reviewer_expertise_signal
per_column.rationale: Reviewer expertise plausibly causes both the amount of detailed product information provided and the perceived helpfulness -- a classic unnamed confounder.

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Category affects both how much product detail is typically written and baseline helpfulness votes; a common cause not named in the query.

per_column.name: use_case_context
per_column.rationale: The use case can influence both the detail provided and reader-perceived helpfulness; plausible unnamed common cause.

per_column.name: purchase_or_delivery_detail
per_column.rationale: Whether the review mentions purchase/delivery is a competing content type more like an alternative outcome of writing choices than a common cause of both treatment and helpfulness; weak as a confounder.

judge.rationale: The set cleanly captures the intervenable treatment ('more detailed product information') across several settable content dimensions, satisfying claim (a). It also supplies multiple plausible confounders -- reviewer expertise, product category, sentiment, and use-case context -- that are common causes of both the detail level and helpfulness and are NOT named in the query, demonstrating the capability under test. review_narrative_type is best read as a mediator and purchase_or_delivery_detail as an alternative-content collider, so they do not count as confounders, but enough genuine unnamed confounders remain for a solid what-if design.
